    Join the Adventure

    If your child is interested in joining the adventure at 7th Swindon Scouts, we'd love to welcome them to our growing community of young people developing skills for life.

    Young People

    Join our waiting list and we'll be in touch when a space becomes available in your local section.

    Age requirement: Children must be aged 5 or above to join.

    Join Waiting List →

    We're always looking for volunteers to help us provide incredible experiences. Whatever your skills, there's a role for you.

    7th Swindon Scout Group

    Part of Swindon North Scout District, we're one of the largest Scout Groups in North Swindon, helping over 300 young people develop skills for life every week.

    Safeguarding

    The safety and wellbeing of young people is our top priority. All our adult volunteers are DBS checked and complete regular safeguarding training. We follow The Scout Association's safeguarding policies and procedures.

    If you have any safeguarding concerns, please see our safeguarding page, contact our Group Lead Volunteer at glv@7thswindon.org.uk, or visit The Scout Association's safeguarding information.
